summary: 10 of 12 well-known analog sites land in the top 10% of Earth for the target they are used for.

tests.name: Known analogs rank high
tests.result: 10 of 12 known analog sites fall in our top 10% for their target (target 70%).

tests.name: The right analog wins
tests.result: Icy sites beat dry ones for Mars ice targets, and dry ones win for Jezero and Gale, in 9 of 10 target pairs.

tests.name: Beats a simple baseline
tests.result: Ranking by dryness and cold alone gets 6 of the 10 pairs right; the seven factors get 9.

tests.name: Wrong places rank low
tests.result: Humid farmland, temperate grassland and a city edge all land in Earth's bottom 15%.
